Rule (real years): Every pixel takes the majority class of its eight 2020 neighbours
Every pixel takes the majority class of its 2020 3x3 window
Previous changers take the majority class of their eight 2020 neighbours
Revert to the 2015 class if changed 2015->2020
Revert to the 2010 class if changed 2015->2020
Revert to the modal 2005-2020 class if changed 2015->2020
Continue: previous changers move to their class's most likely destination
Revert to the modal class if changed twice (2010->2015 and 2015->2020)
